guardrails.name: Quarantine over delete
guardrails.detail: safe-git moves colliding untracked files to _ATTIC (never `git clean -fd`).

guardrails.name: Message-file commits
guardrails.detail: commit messages go through a UTF-8 file (`commit -F`) — no shell mangling.

guardrails.name: History backup fresh
guardrails.detail: no recent history bundle — run `python -m src.git_safe backup` before risky ops.

guardrails.name: JSON integrity
guardrails.detail: all top-level data/ + docs/ JSON parses.

guardrails.name: No rebase-blocking collisions
guardrails.detail: no untracked file collides with incoming commits.

guardrails.name: Handoff mentions live build
guardrails.detail: handoff does not mention the live build (v90) — update §0d so no context is lost.
